measure.justification: z=cos(theta), surface area element sin(theta)dtheta dphi = |dz|dphi

notation.tolerance: L2 norm bound, not squared error

general_formulas.scaling: Under t=B*x, homogeneous squared residual integral scales by B^(1-2*p).
general_formulas.rational_root_coordinates: For p=m/d, t=R^d makes profile moments powers d*(k+1)-m and squared-profile norm powers d-2*m; exact rational roots/endpoints preserve rational integrals.

assumptions_and_limits: No solver implementation or frozen file was modified.
Truncation numbers use an ideal model exact outside |z|<epsilon, with its full L2 tolerance spent inside.
Rounded decimal thresholds are explanatory evaluations of exact expressions, not outward-rounded certificates.
Dyadic scale depth is not a required uniform point count or an observed solver configuration.
A singular basis containing the original function changes the permitted representation; its formal exactness is not an existing piecewise-polynomial certificate or a spectrum result.
The existing degree-24 global projection was evaluated read-only for diagnosis; it was not substituted into the official evaluation.
